Messages.Body:
If Kyoko plays Abactor, then does she steal 5 blood from another
vampire?

Messages.Author: bwr...@mail.com
Messages.Body:
On Jun 6, 1:46 am, XZealot <xzea...@cox.net> wrote:
> If Kyoko plays Abactor, then does she steal 5 blood from another
> vampire?

Of course not. Abactor is just a different non-standard hunt, just
like her special. Putting them together is like having Cybele take a
Legal Manipulations action and then trying to apply the bleed from her
special bleed action. It doesn't work because they're two different
actions.

Brent Ross

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He's implying that Kyoko's text gives her the ability to take a specific action.
Just like Govern gives her the ability to take a (different) specific action.

See also Rafaele Giovanni's text (another action): Rafaele cannot use Govern +
his special to bleed his predator for 3 (well, 4 with his other special, but you
get the idea). They're two different actions.

Similarly, Abactor provides yet another action. Kyoko cannot take both the
Abactor action and her special ability action in one action. Having two
available bleed actions is not the same as having two enhancements that can be
applied to any bleed action.
